It's unbelievable that there is a place like this\nbeneath the forest...
What's wrong? Are you okay?!
Y-yes, I'm fine...
Sorry, but I'd like to send the soldiers back to\nErva Tronc, is that okay?
C-captain?! What are you talking about?!
I-it's fine with us, but why so sudden?
The temperature here is pretty high.\nSince the Eumanos are a kind of plant,\nthis environment may be too harsh for them...
The Eumanos are a species that evolved from\nplants. So it will be difficult to survive in a\nhigh temperature and low moisture environment...
I want them to get out of here as soon as\npossible.
B-but, we can't just go and leave everything to\nthe adventurers...
Don't worry, I'll go with the adventurers...
Wait, wait, wait!\nYou're a Eumano too, you know?!
It's okay. I feel like I can handle high\ntemperature and harsh environment now.\nMaybe it's because I've become a Sproutling...
Thank you!!
Everyone, please return to Erva Tronc and explain\nthe situation to Leader Kinda!
If we don't return after 5 days, ask the\nSproutlings to form a team to perform a\nreinvestigation!
Understood!\nCaptain, adventurers, please be careful!!
Wow~...You're starting to act like a captain now!\nBut still, things are unbelievable here, you won't\nsee 'em in our world...
Wow~...You're starting to act like a captain now!\nBut still, things are unbelievable here, you won't\nsee 'em in our world...Oh, whoa, whoa, whoa?!
Er...All of them are dead...What's going on here?
I wonder who beat all these Coenubias at once...
A-are you a weredragon?!
Weredragons are called Dragists, and they're said\nto have appeared and caused troubles from time to\ntime before the Cataclysm in our world happened...
Oh, I'm surprised that you know about us.\nI see you guys are not from here.
Are you one of the dragons that ravage the\nforest?!
Hey, come on. It's true that they and I are of the\nsame root, in fact, I'm still working with some of\nthem, but
I'm not gonna be happy if you lump me in with\nthose troublemakers that run around doing random\nstupid stuff.
What are weredragons doing in this world though?\nDon't tell me this is actually your world and\nyou guys came to our world from here?
Oh~, you two are the inhabitants of the world up\nthere...And you're the inhabitant of this forest,\nright?
In that case, you guys aren't our enemies.\nJust go home...
*pissed*\nAre you saying that we're no match for you?!
No, um...He's probably saying that we're not the\nones they should be fighting.
O-oh, really? I'm sorry then...\nSo. are you guys fighting against Coenubias by any\nchance...?
Yeah...They're our enemies and we're not planning\nto get anyone else involved in our fight...
A-actually, Coenubia is a big problem that we\nEumanos are already involved in!
I don't really know what kind of beings you are,\nbut I know that I can't just leave them to you!
...He's right. We're also indebted to the Eumanos,\nso we can't just pretend that we don't know about\nit.
...Alright if you insist. But I don't care if you\nget killed. You're responsible for your life.\nMy name is Zianga. Well, follow me then...
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go back for now!
Explore this place a little longer!
